brand_tone: Legacy, Masterful, Precision, Structural Excellence, Premium.
concept: A fresh distinctive modern take replacing the old dark luxury theme with a structural, light-themed 'Architectural Brutalism' mixed with earthy warmth. It balances the stark, precise reality of engineering with the organic warmth of landscapes and interiors.

rules: Avoid completely flat whites; use 'Bone-white' or 'Stone' (#F4F3EF) to give a tactile, earthy feel.
Use #C55B43 (Terracotta) for primary CTAs and active states.
Never use pure black #000000. Use Charcoal #1A1A1A.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid colors.
Headings MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) to feel structural.
Overlines and labels MUST be uppercase with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use typography to create tension: Massive headings against very structured, dense body content.

marketing.spacing: Use 2x-3x typical spacing. py-24, py-32 for sections.
marketing.grid: Bento 'Tetris' grid. Asymmetry, Visual Tension. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
marketing.hero: Massive typography, high-quality architectural imagery, offset alignments.
marketing.components: Custom HTML/Tailwind for layouts, Shadcn only for complex forms.

dashboard.spacing: Tight, dense spacing. p-4 to p-6 for cards.
dashboard.grid: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4.
dashboard.components: Shadcn UI exclusively. Use flat, sharp borders, max rounded-sm.
dashboard.patterns: Top-left KPI focus, progressive disclosure, modular widgets, timeline views.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' (The Technical Look) - expose the skeleton of the UI with 1px border-border/40 lines.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use crisp 1px borders instead of soft shadows. If shadows are needed, use sharp, geometric shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0_rgba(26,26,26,1)]).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in dashboards. Use sparingly in marketing sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F4F3EF]/80).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlays to make the background feel like drafting paper or concrete.

motion.marketing: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered reveals, parallax on images, and smooth page transitions.
motion.dashboard: Minimalist. Fast hover states, quick slide-ins for sidebars.

component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. Use Terracotta for primary. Include hover states (translate-y-[-1px], deeper color).
component_instructions.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#EAE7DF), no shadow by default. Hover adds sharp shadow.
component_instructions.tables: Shadcn tables. Dense, left-aligned, clear status badges.
component_instructions.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Distinct focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-terracotta/50).

media.icons: lucide-react for standard icons. Consider iconoir-react for a more architectural line-drawing feel if needed.

rules: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
All interactive elements MUST have visible focus states.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='client-login-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use centered generic layouts for marketing pages. Use optical alignment and asymmetric bento grids.
For the dashboards (Admin, Client, Contractor), ensure a high-density, highly functional layout with a left sidebar.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing complex layouts, avoid generic Shadcn cards to prevent the 'Vercel-look'.
Use Shadcn UI for the dashboards and all form components.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or fixed headers where content scrolls underneath.
Do NOT use AI emoji characters.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all interactive elements for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. DO NOT center align the app container. DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use sonner for toasts.
